WORKLOG - card_billing_payments_and_disputes, task 0 (round 1)

STEP 0 - DRAW AND SCOPE
Command: .venv/bin/python skills/erl-task-instantiate/scripts/draw_counts.py env/regional_retail_bank/tasks/card_billing_payments_and_disputes --tasks 2
Output: {"task": 0, "key": "regional_retail_bank/card_billing_payments_and_disputes/0", "prerequisite_problems": 1, "problems": 2, "factor_counts": [4, 4]}
        {"task": 1, "key": "regional_retail_bank/card_billing_payments_and_disputes/1", "prerequisite_problems": 2, "problems": 3, "factor_counts": [5, 5, 6]}
Task 0 therefore has exactly one prerequisite problem (two problems in all) and one drawn factor count of 4 for each of them. card_ext_late_fee_correction takes 4 factors and card_ext_rewards_statement_credit takes 4.

Occupied before this task: nothing (task 0 is first). Claimed by this task: the policies card_ext_late_fee_correction and card_ext_rewards_statement_credit, the base events card_fee_reversal and card_rewards_redeem, and the tools reverse_card_late_fee_4ff0f41c (agent) and redeem_card_points_9bfb7edb (user). Left for task 1, which needs three problems: card_dispute_credit (the provisional credit on a billing dispute), card_dispute_rebill (recovering a temporary credit on a dispute resolved against the cardholder) and card_set_autopay (the cardholder's own standing instruction), with their base policies card_evt_billing_disputes and card_evt_payments untouched here. Task 1 therefore keeps three independent, load-bearing policy cores with their own base lineage, and nothing this task claims is needed there.

DESIGN THESIS
Surface goal: the cardholder wants her rewards points applied to what she owes on the card. Scored core parameter: the number of points the redemption uses. Between the two lies a policy prerequisite the customer never mentions: the redemption's settlement target is drawn from the fees and interest standing inside a window, net of the fee reversals credited inside it, and the charter states that the point count is fixed only after every late payment fee entry on the account carries a matching reversal entry. The ledger shows one late payment fee with no reversal against it, so the agent must first discover, apply and post the late payment fee correction, and only then compute the redemption on the world that write leaves behind.
Chain drawn: surface goal (apply my points) -> read the redemption policy -> its prerequisite sentence names a record-visible state (every late payment fee carries a matching reversal entry) -> check the ledger, find the 2026-03-08 fee unreversed -> find the one policy of this difficulty whose write books a reversal entry on a late payment fee -> compute and post that correction -> recompute the settlement window on the new ledger -> compute and hand over the redemption -> terminal state: one card_fee_reversal row of 23.00, one card_rewards_redeem row of 33,000 points, balance owed 5,981.95 and 7,876 unredeemed points.
Depth: two hops, not swappable - the correction changes an input of the redemption, and the redemption changes nothing the correction reads. Breadth at each hop: the correction reads the card fee ledger, the twelve-month purchase total, the six-month payment count, the checking tier, the checking ledger balance, the six-month checking deposit total, the savings balance and the three-month savings deposit count; the redemption reads three candidate fee-and-interest windows, the twelve-month payment count, the checking tier, the six-month checking deposit total and checking fee count, the savings balance, the three-month savings interest count, the account age and the count of earlier redemptions.

BASE-INVARIANT CARD
Write subject card_fee_reversal. Every base policy whose subject intersects it: card_evt_fee_reversal only (checked against products/card.yaml: no other policy lists card_fee_reversal). Its four eligibility gates all apply to card_fee_reversal and are all inherited; none is named in overwrite, because the overwrite quotes only the amount clause "A fee is reversed in full, never in part, as one card_fee_reversal row whose source_item_id is the fee."
  courtesy_count - "The customer's courtesy late fee reversals in the rolling 365 days ... must be below the tier's late_fee_courtesy_waivers_365d." Authority: system record. Object correlation: card_transactions.customer_id bound to the call's customer_id. At frozen_time 2026-03-17 the only courtesy-waiver late fee reversal on file posted 2024-08-20, 574 days earlier, so the rolling count is 0 and the tier allowance for Cash Rewards Visa is 1: satisfied. Negative case: had that reversal posted on or after 2025-03-18 the count would be 1 and the gate would fail.
  prior_on_time - "The payment history immediately before the late statement must show at least late_fee_courtesy_min_prior_on_time consecutive on-time payments." The tier requires 6. The statement that closed 2026-02-08 is the late one; the six statements closing 2025-08-08 through 2026-01-08 were each paid before their due dates by the payments of 2025-09-01, 2025-10-01, 2025-11-01, 2025-12-01, 2026-01-01 and 2026-02-01: satisfied at exactly the threshold. Negative case: move the 2025-09-01 payment to 2025-09-20 and the run drops to five.
  account_open_for_courtesy - "The account must be active or suspended when a courtesy reversal is granted." card_accounts.status is active: satisfied.
  reverse_once - "A fee can be reversed at most once." No card_fee_reversal row names the 2026-03-08 fee as its source item: satisfied. The 2024-08-08 fee is already reversed, which is exactly why it is not the object of this write.
No gate of card_evt_fee_reversal is of kind time, so temporal_feasibility is [] for this step.
Write subject card_rewards_redeem. Governing base policy: card_evt_rewards only. Its single gate applying to card_rewards_redeem is redeem_while_active - "Redemption is allowed only while the account is active." card_accounts.status is active at the moment of the write: satisfied; the preceding correction write does not change status. No time gate here either.

BUSINESS-OBJECT CARD
Target object of the correction: the single card ledger entry with event_type card_fee and fee_code late_payment posted 2026-03-08 for statement cycle 2026-02. Correlation key: its own card_txn_id, written into the new reversal row as source_item_id. Rows included in its calculation: the most recent late payment fee (selected by posted date over the two such entries), the fifteen card purchases filtered to the twelve-month window, the eighteen card payments filtered to the six-month window. Rows excluded and why: the 2024-08-08 late payment fee (not the most recent), the 2025-03-10 purchase of 1,240.00 (twelve whole months before the frozen date, outside the window), the six payments of 2023-12-01 through 2025-09-01 (outside the six-month window). Already settled: the 2024-08-08 fee was settled in full by the 2024-08-20 courtesy reversal that names it as its source item, so it cannot be double-credited and it is not the object here.
Target object of the redemption: the card account's unredeemed points balance. Correlation key: card_account_id. Rows included: every card_fee and card_interest_charge row inside the selected window and every card_fee_reversal row inside it, plus the count of card_rewards_redeem rows on the account. Rows excluded: the 2025-09-08 interest charge of 47.60 and the 2024-08 fee and reversal pair, all outside the six-month window; the three earlier redemptions and their statement credits are counted only as a count of redemptions, never as amounts.

PROBLEM-TREE CARD
Root problem: card_ext_rewards_statement_credit (the problem the caller's surface request points at). Prerequisite problem: card_ext_late_fee_correction. One edge, matching the draw of 1.
Edge card_ext_rewards_statement_credit <- card_ext_late_fee_correction
  kind: value_input. gate: the compute binding settlement_target of the root policy.
  form: state. Prerequisite sentence, carried verbatim in the root policy's own rule: "The number of points a statement-credit redemption uses is fixed only after every late payment fee entry standing on the card account carries a matching reversal entry in the ledger."
  Four-point test: (1) the ordering connective is "only after", joining this policy's own result (the number of points a statement-credit redemption uses) to what it waits on; (2) the XX side is a record-visible state - late payment fee entries and reversal entries in the ledger, named in the words the card ledger and its finder use - and no action, performer or tool is named; (3) no tool name, no policy id, no snake_case token and no row id appears; (4) the strength is a hard requirement ("only after") over a closed, exactly-scoped set - every late payment fee entry standing on the account - which is exactly the edge condition, neither wider nor narrower.
  Exactly one write of this difficulty brings that state about: card_ext_late_fee_correction is the only policy whose subject is card_fee_reversal and whose target tool books a reversal entry naming a late payment fee as its source item. No other policy of this difficulty writes into card_transactions with that fee code, so the hop resolves uniquely.
  Derivation the reader performs: the sentence says the point count waits on a state of the ledger; the ledger lookup shows two late payment fee entries, of which only the 2024-08-08 one is named as a source item by a reversal; therefore the state does not hold; the only rule of the charter whose result is a reversal entry against a late payment fee is the late payment fee correction, whose own rule says that credit is owed as soon as the fee stands and is posted at the next reconciliation; therefore the correction must be computed and posted first. Exactly one reading.
  Handling-time condition: every card ledger entry on the account with the late payment fee code is named as the source item of a fee reversal entry on the same account.
  Resolving action: reverse_card_late_fee_4ff0f41c, owner agent.
  Seed evidence that it is false at the opening: initial_state.card_transactions.<late fee>.fee_code = late_payment, posted_date = 2026-03-08, and no card_fee_reversal row in the seed carries that card_txn_id as source_item_id (the only reversal in the seed carries the 2024-08-08 fee).
  Topological order: card_ext_late_fee_correction, then card_ext_rewards_statement_credit. No parallel edges exist, so there is nothing to reorder; order_uniqueness records this.
  Deletion sensitivity, from the Step 5 run: skipping the correction write leaves reversals inside the six-month window at 0.00, the settlement target at 435.35 instead of 412.35, the quotient at 34,828 instead of 32,988 and the scored points at 35,000 instead of 33,000; the terminal DB also loses the reversal row and keeps the balance at 6,004.95.
  The customer never mentions it: see prerequisite_closure.no_user_hint. The tools never check it: see prerequisite_closure.tools_do_not_block.
  At least one problem of the tree is the customer's own write: the root problem's target tool redeem_card_points_9bfb7edb is owner=user. Redeeming points is the cardholder's disposal of her own property and the value lands on her own account, so the in-person semantics are genuine, and the write completes on the spot inside the same frozen_time - nothing is pending, nothing clears later.

WHY IT MAKES A GOOD TEST
It forces the capability a real card desk needs: read a policy that states what its own result waits on, notice from the ledger that the state does not hold, work out which other rule brings it about, do that one first, and only then compute the number the caller actually asked about - on the ledger as it now stands, not as it stood when the call opened. The difficulty is not tool choice: both tools are named by the knowledge base and nothing else in the difficulty writes a fee reversal or a redemption. It is reading and arithmetic. Eight ladder tiers have to be decided from records (checking tier, payment counts over two different windows, a twelve-month purchase total with a boundary purchase inside it, a checking ledger balance, a six-month checking deposit total, a checking fee just outside the six-month window, a savings balance, savings deposits and interest credits inside three months, account age and a count of earlier redemptions), and two of them are near-misses that bite.

FACTOR CARD - card_ext_late_fee_correction (4 factors, matching the drawn count)
  credited_share_ladder, effect parameter, cross_difficulty checking, multi-source. Ladder: Premier or Private Client checking AND at least payments_lookback_high card payments in six months -> credited_share_enhanced; any other active checking tier AND at least payments_lookback_low payments in six months -> credited_share_mid; otherwise credited_share_standard. Tier taken here: the first. Evidence rows: the Premier Checking holding, and the card payments of 2025-10-01, 2025-11-01, 2025-12-01, 2026-01-01, 2026-02-01 and 2026-03-09. Baseline reading: credited_share_standard, which gives result 13.00 instead of 23.00 (verified run).
  relationship_addition_ladder, effect parameter, cross_difficulty checking, multi-source. Ladder as in the rule. Tier taken: the first. Evidence rows: the ten card purchases inside the twelve-month window totalling 9,659.85, and the Premier Checking ledger_balance of 6,240.18. Baseline reading: no addition, giving 21.00.
  addition_entry_point, effect method, cross_difficulty checking, multi-source. It changes the order of two operations: whether the addition enters before or after the share acts, or not at all. Tier taken: the first (81 whole months open, 13,080.00 of deposits). Evidence rows: card_accounts.opened_date and the six checking direct deposits. Baseline reading: the share on the fee alone, giving 21.00.
  correction_rounding_convention, effect method, cross_difficulty savings, multi-source. It changes the rounding mode and precision. Tier taken: the first (money market balance 31,480.55, one deposit inside three months). Evidence rows: the savings holding and the 2026-01-20 deposit. Baseline reading: half-up to the cent, giving 23.40.
  Whole baseline (all four at their fall-through): 11.20, different from the scored 23.00.
  Near-miss records: the 2025-03-25 purchase of 1,760.00 sits inside the twelve-month window by eight days, and dropping it takes the twelve-month total to 7,899.85 and the relationship addition down a tier; the 2025-12-05 savings deposit sits outside the three-month window, and counting it would not change the tier here but counting it while missing the 2026-01-20 deposit would. No field of card_accounts or card_transactions names any of these outcomes; there is no "relief applies" stamp anywhere in the schema and no rule reads one.
FACTOR CARD - card_ext_rewards_statement_credit (4 factors, matching the drawn count)
  settlement_window_convention, effect method, cross_difficulty checking, multi-source. It changes the window convention the target is aggregated over: six months, three months or one month. Tier taken: the first. Evidence rows: the six checking direct deposits totalling 13,080.00 and the absence of any checking fee inside six months. Baseline reading: the one-month window, giving 6,500.
  covered_share_ladder, effect parameter, cross_difficulty checking, multi-source. Tier taken: the first. Evidence: the Premier Checking holding and twelve card payments inside twelve months. Baseline: covered_share_standard, giving 18,500.
  redemption_value_ladder, effect parameter, cross_difficulty savings, multi-source. Tier taken: the first. Evidence: the money market balance and the savings interest credits of 2026-01-31 and 2026-02-28. Baseline: the tier's own cash value of 0.01, giving 40,876 after the points cap.
  point_count_rounding, effect method, evidence history and date. It changes the rounding convention of the point count. Tier taken: the first (81 months open, three earlier redemptions). Baseline: half-up to a whole point, giving 32,988.
  Whole baseline: 4,144, different from the scored 33,000.
  Near-miss records: the interest charge of 2025-09-08 is exactly six whole months old at the frozen date and therefore outside the six-month window - counting it raises interest_6m to 409.35, the settlement target to 459.95 and the answer to 37,000; it is excluded by the rule alone, from the posted date the ledger shows. The second limb of this factor's first tier - that no PCB checking fee falls inside the last six months - is established by reading the checking ledger and finding no checking fee on it at any date, which is what the checking charter requires of this account: Premier Checking waives its monthly maintenance fee for any cycle in which the relationship balance reaches waiver_relationship_balance of 25,000.00, and this customer's PCB deposit balances (checking 6,240.18 plus money market 31,480.55 = 37,720.73) clear it at every cycle close in the seeded span.
No base product law was created. The correction refines card_evt_fee_reversal's amount clause and declares that override; the redemption refines card_evt_rewards' valuation and quantity clause and declares that override. Every other clause of both base policies - the fee-reversal gates, the dispute_final ground, the earning rates, the forfeiture rules, the whole-points requirement and the redemption minimum - stays in force and is inherited.

SEED - WHY EACH CLASS OF ROW EXISTS
customers: the single profile; its phone, date of birth, SSN last four and ZIP are the locating and verification credentials, and its date of birth also proves the tier's age gate was met at opening. Remove it and nothing can be located.
card_accounts: the holding. variant_name fixes every tier parameter (point value, redemption minimum, courtesy allowance, prior-on-time requirement, late fee rates); opened_date fixes the 81-month age both method factors test; status satisfies two eligibility gates; rewards_balance caps the redemption; current_balance, last_statement_balance and minimum_payment_due reconcile to the ledger.
card_transactions purchases (15): the ten inside the twelve-month window decide the relationship addition tier; the five outside it are the distractors that make the window a real filter, one of them (2025-03-10) deliberately adjacent to the boundary. Remove the 2025-03-25 purchase and the addition drops from 4.00 to 2.00 and the answer from 23.00 to 21.00.
card_transactions rewards earn rows (15): they make the unredeemed points balance the ledger rather than a bare number, at the tier's own 3-per-dollar bonus rate inside the quarterly cap and 1.5 otherwise.
card_transactions payments (18): the six inside six months decide the credited share tier, the twelve inside twelve months decide the covered share tier, and the six statements before the late one are the prior_on_time evidence. Remove one of the six recent payments and the credited share falls a tier.
card_transactions interest (9): six inside the six-month window make up 361.75 of the settlement target; the 2025-09-08 charge is the boundary distractor; the two earlier ones give the account a credible revolving history.
card_transactions fees (4): the 2026-03-08 late payment fee is the object of the correction and the thing that makes the prerequisite false; the cash advance and foreign transaction fees are real charges inside the window that enlarge the settlement target and are correctly derived from their source items; the 2024-08-08 late fee plus its reversal are the courtesy_count evidence and the proof that "every late payment fee carries a matching reversal" is a state that some fees already satisfy.
card_transactions redemptions and their statement credits (6): three earlier redemptions put the account on the first tier of the point-count rounding ladder; remove one and the rounding drops to hundreds and the answer to 32,988 rounded up to 33,000 - in fact to 33,000 as well for this quotient, so the seed keeps three to leave the tier unambiguous, and their statement credits keep the balance honest.
checking_accounts: Premier Checking decides two share ladders; its ledger_balance decides the addition ladder.
checking_transactions (6): six direct deposits totalling 13,080.00 decide two method ladders. The ledger deliberately carries no checking fee of any kind, because Premier Checking's relationship-balance waiver is met at every cycle close for this customer and the checking charter assesses no monthly maintenance fee where a waiver is met; seeding one at any amount or date would be a row that product could not produce.
savings_accounts: the money market balance decides the rounding ladder and the redemption value ladder.
savings_transactions (4): one deposit inside three months and one outside it, two interest credits inside three months; remove the 2026-01-20 deposit and the correction rounds to the cent instead of the dollar.
Automatic-clause check: base card_evt_delinquency would suspend at 60 days past due and charge off at 180; days_past_due is 0, so neither fires. card_evt_annual_fee bills nothing because the tier's annual_fee is 0.00. card_evt_penalty_and_military_rates does not fire: military_status is none and days_past_due is 0. card_evt_interest bills at statement close only, and the most recent close is already seeded. No seeded row lights an obligation this task set does not carry. No cache field is used as a trap in this task: current_balance and rewards_balance agree with the ledger, and both computations read the ledger rather than the cache.

PERSONA
Delia is written as a hurried, practical school office manager who states her goal in one sentence and then answers. Her voice carries the whole design: she volunteers only the surface request and her willingness to press the button herself; she gives identity details one at a time and only when asked, in a fixed order, so the verification step has a definite path; she cannot value a point and says so, which removes any chance of her anchoring the arithmetic; she has no target figure, which closes the "how much do you want to cover" question without giving gold a value; she refers balances to the agent rather than misremembering them, so no second truth is created beside the system record. Her only reaction to the correction is a pleased remark after the agent has said something was put back, which fires on an utterance event and never on the DB. She asks for nothing after the redemption confirmation - no letter, no statement, no address - so her arc ends exactly where evaluation_criteria ends.

REACHABILITY IN ONE CONVERSATION
Turn by turn: she states the goal and her name; the agent locates her by mobile number and name; the agent asks for credentials and she gives date of birth, SSN last four and ZIP in that order; the agent reads the card account, the card ledger, the checking account and ledger, the savings account and ledger - every one of those is a share tool callable by name with arguments she has already made reachable; the agent computes the correction from the policy and posts it through unlock then call; the agent computes the point count on the ledger that write leaves, unlocks the redemption, hands it to her and she runs it; she reads back the confirmation and the call ends. Every question a real agent would ask has a written answer: where the points should land, whether she has a target, what else she holds at PCB, how she pays. Nothing waits on a diagnosis, a delivery, a clearing, a review or a future date; both writes land synchronously at 2026-03-17 10:40:00 EST and are confirmable on the spot.

STEP 5 - VERIFICATION RUN
Harness: the seed builder and a driver that imports build_env / eval_compute / substitute from skills/erl-task-instantiate/scripts/check_compute.py, evaluates the correction on initial_state, replays the real reverse_card_late_fee_4ff0f41c through ToolContext onto a seeded DB, then evaluates the redemption on the resulting world.
Output:
  correction_amount = 23.0   (history rows touched 18, branches 15)
     credited_share_ladder baseline -> 13.0
     relationship_addition_ladder baseline -> 21.0
     addition_entry_point baseline -> 21.0
     correction_rounding_convention baseline -> 23.4
     ALL baseline -> 11.2
  tool receipt: "Fee correction ... credited 23.00 USD against fee ... ; balance owed is now 5981.95 USD."
  points_redeemed = 33000.0  (history rows touched 25, branches 18)
     settlement_window_convention baseline -> 6500.0
     covered_share_ladder baseline -> 18500.0
     redemption_value_ladder baseline -> 40876.0
     point_count_rounding baseline -> 32988.0
     ALL baseline -> 4144.0
     prerequisite skipped -> 35000.0
Every declared factor moves the result; both whole baselines differ from gold; the prerequisite edge is load-bearing. These figures are copied unchanged into computations.expected, baseline_result, factor_sensitivity and edge_load_bearing.

RULE / COMPUTE TWO-WAY SWEEP
Forward: every binding of both policies that reads the world or makes a choice carries a verbatim rule quotation in compute_basis - the aggregations (LATEST over late payment fees, COUNT over payments, SUM over purchases and over fees, interest and reversals in three windows, XSUM over checking deposits, XCOUNT over checking fees and over savings deposits and interest credits), the cross-category reads (CFIELD on checking tier and ledger balance, CFIELD and EXISTS on savings), every ladder binding, the rounding bindings and the two caps. Reverse: reading each rule through, the load-bearing sentences are the selection of the fee by posted date (LATEST), the three credited-share tiers (the credited_share ternary), the three addition tiers (the relationship_addition ternary), the three entry-point tiers (the raw_correction ternary), the three rounding tiers (the rounded_correction ternary), the final lesser-of clause (MN), and on the redemption side the three window tiers, the three covered-share tiers, the three redemption-value tiers, the three point-count tiers, the never-less-than-zero clauses (MX) and the lesser-of against the unredeemed points (MN). Each is implemented; no sentence is unclaimed and no filter appears in an expression that the quoted sentence does not carry. Sensitive-word cross-check: "in the last six months" / "in the last three months" / "in the last twelve months" / "in the last month" each correspond to a within_months argument; "never less than zero" to MX; "the lesser of" to MN; "rounded half-up to the cent" to RND(x, 2); "rounded half-up to the nearest whole dollar" to RND(x, 0); "reduced to the whole dollar below it" to float(int(x)); "raised to the next whole multiple of five hundred points" and "of one hundred points" to the ceiling expressions. The order and grouping the two method ladders turn on are written out in full in both rules ("added to the fee as billed first and the credited share acts on that total" against "acts on the fee as billed alone and the relationship addition is added to the product afterwards"), so no reader is left to guess.

SOLVABILITY EVIDENCE AGAINST GOLD
Step 9 declares all four gates of card_evt_fee_reversal, each with pre-action system evidence correlated to the call's own arguments: the customer id binding for courtesy_count, the card account id binding for prior_on_time and account_open_for_courtesy, and the fee's own card_txn_id bound to source_item_id for reverse_once. Step 11 declares redeem_while_active with the account row and status. The state fact of step 9 is created by the call itself, and the state fact of step 11 cites prior_step:9 - no status registration stands in for a real-world event anywhere, and no persona line is used as authority for an internal fact.

DRAFT RECOMPUTATION FROM THE VISIBLE CONTEXT
Masking the extended yaml, compute, expected, gold and this dossier, and working only from what the published knowledge base will carry, the tool schemas, the rows the share tools return and the persona's actual lines: the caller wants points applied to the card. The redemption rule says the point count is fixed only after every late payment fee entry carries a matching reversal entry; find_card_transactions shows two late payment fee entries and one reversal, naming the 2024 fee, so the state is false. The only rule whose result is such a reversal entry is the late payment fee correction, whose own rule says the credit is owed as soon as the fee stands. Compute it: fee 32.00; Premier Checking and six payments in six months give the enhanced share; 9,659.85 of purchases and a 6,240.18 balance give the high addition; 81 months open and 13,080.00 of deposits put the addition before the share; a 31,480.55 money market balance with a deposit inside three months rounds to the dollar; 23.00, under the 32.00 cap. Post it. Then the redemption: deposits over 12,000 and no checking fee inside six months select the six-month window; 73.60 of fees plus 361.75 of interest less the 23.00 just credited gives 412.35; Premier plus twelve payments give the full covered share; the money market balance with interest inside three months gives 0.0125; 32,988 raised to the next five hundred is 33,000, below the 40,876 on the account. Both figures agree with gold, and no second reading of the visible text produces a different object, order or value.

CLOSURE
policy -> target_tool -> computation -> GT call -> terminal state:
  card_ext_late_fee_correction -> reverse_card_late_fee_4ff0f41c -> computations[0] (step 9, arg correction_amount, 23.0) -> evaluation_criteria[9] -> one card_fee_reversal row and balance 5,981.95.
  card_ext_rewards_statement_credit -> redeem_card_points_9bfb7edb -> computations[1] (step 11, arg points_redeemed, 33000) -> evaluation_criteria[11] -> one card_rewards_redeem row and 7,876 points remaining.
set(computations.policy_id) equals charter_scope.extended_policies equals required_documents equals the problems of the tree. No policy, route or tool is reserved, and no obligation is left undischarged: the only state_due policy the seed lights is the late payment fee correction, and this task carries it.

REVISION - ROUND 2 (policy-task audit rework)

FIND-0-1, SOURCE-FACTOR RED - closed.
  Symptom as filed: the cross-difficulty evidence row deciding settlement_window_convention was
  initial_state.checking_transactions.3d2babbb-38d9-4c59-aa84-2d18d010e1ea, a checking_fee with fee_code
  monthly_maintenance, amount 12.00, posted_date 2025-09-11, on a Premier Checking account whose
  statement_cycle_day is 20; the checking charter puts the fee at 25.00 and posts it on the cycle closing
  date, so the very field that kept the row outside the six-month window was the field that contradicted
  the charter. The auditor demonstrated that re-dating it to the charter-required 2025-09-20 moves
  checking_fees_6m from 0 to 1 and points_redeemed from 33,000 to 18,500.
  Root cause: the row was seeded as a decorative distractor without checking it against
  checking_evt_maintenance_and_statement_fees.
  Change: the row is deleted, not re-dated. Re-dating it would still leave a row that product cannot
  produce. checking_evt_maintenance_and_statement_fees assesses the monthly maintenance fee "unless at
  least one waiver offered by the tier is met for that cycle", and Premier Checking offers
  waiver_relationship_balance 25,000.00 measured by checking_msr_relationship_balance at the cycle
  closing date - "the customer's deposit balances at PCB summed across checking, savings and certificate
  holdings". This customer's checking ledger balance is 6,240.18 and her Money Market Account balance is
  31,480.55, a relationship balance of 37,720.73, and it stays above 25,000.00 at every cycle close in
  the seeded span (the two savings deposits of 2025-12-05 and 2026-01-20 total only 3,500.00, so the
  earliest seeded cycle close still clears the threshold). The waiver is therefore met every month, and a

user_scenario:
Delia Hargrove is forty-six, a school office manager in Greensboro who has banked at Piedmont Crescent for years and does most of it on her phone at the kitchen table. She calls the Care Center in the middle of a weekday morning, friendly but plainly in a hurry, because she has been staring at the rewards total on her credit card and it irritates her that it just sits there doing nothing. She says what she wants in her first breath: "I'd like to put my points toward what I owe on the card, today if you can do it while I've got you."

She is happy for the representative to do the arithmetic - "you tell me the number, I'm no good at that" - but she would rather press the button herself if that is how it works, so when the agent hands the action over to her she runs it and reads back whatever the confirmation says. She has no idea what a point is worth and will say so if asked; she has never worked it out and is not going to guess at it now.

She gives her name, Delia Hargrove, straight away, and her mobile number, 3365550412, when the agent asks how to find her. If she is asked to prove who she is she offers her date of birth, 1979-05-02, then, if that is not enough, the last four of her social, 1427, and after that the ZIP on the house, 27405 - one at a time, a little grudgingly, in that order, and only as each is asked for. She does not volunteer her email address, but if the agent asks for it she gives it as delia.hargrove@carolinamail.com.

If the agent asks whether she wants the points taken as a credit on the card itself or paid out somewhere else, she says she wants it to come straight off the card, nowhere else. If the agent asks how much she is trying to cover, she says she has no figure in mind and would rather the bank apply whatever its rules say. If the agent asks about her other accounts she confirms she keeps a checking account and a money market account at PCB, but she cannot recite balances from memory and tells the agent to look them up. If the agent asks anything about her statements or her payment history she says she pays online every month and leaves the detail to them.

Whenever the agent mentions that something has been put back onto the card, she takes it in good part - "well, that's a nice surprise" - and leaves it there; she does not know what it relates to and does not ask. Once the agent has unlocked the redemption for her and she has run it, she reads out the confirmation, says that is exactly what she was after, thanks them and rings off. She never chases anything further, and if the agent goes quiet or sounds like they are working she simply waits.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.points_redeemed: 33000. PCB checking deposits over the last six months total 13,080.00, at least checking_deposit_volume_high 12,000.00, and the checking ledger carries no PCB checking fee at all, so none falls inside the last six months - the cardholder's PCB deposit balances keep the Premier Checking maintenance fee waived at every cycle close - so the settlement target is drawn from the last six months. Card fees posted in that window total 73.60 (12.60 on 2025-11-22, 29.00 on 2026-01-14 and 32.00 on 2026-03-08) and interest totals 361.75 (58.40, 61.15, 54.70, 63.25, 57.90 and 66.35 for the cycles closing 2025-10-08 through 2026-03-08; the 47.60 charge of 2025-09-08 is six whole months old and falls outside). The fee reversal credited inside the window is the 23.00 correction booked at step 9, so the settlement target is 73.60 + 361.75 - 23.00 = 412.35. The covered share is covered_share_full 1.00, because the cardholder holds an active Premier Checking account and twelve card payments posted to this card in the last twelve months, at least payments_deep_count 6. The redemption value is point_value_enhanced 0.0125, because the money market balance of 31,480.55 is at least savings_relationship_balance 25,000.00 and savings interest credits posted 2026-01-31 and 2026-02-28 fall inside the last three months. 412.35 x 1.00 / 0.0125 = 32,988. The account is 81 whole months old, at least seasoned_account_months 60, and three rewards redemptions have already been posted (2023-06-15, 2024-03-08 and 2025-02-20), at least prior_redemption_count 3, so the quotient is raised to the next whole multiple of five hundred points: 33,000. That is below the 40,876 unredeemed points standing on the account, so the redemption uses 33,000 points.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: The tree has one edge and therefore one topological order: the correction is written first and the redemption second. There are no parallel prerequisites to reorder, and the redemption's own write touches nothing the correction reads - it books a rewards row and lowers the points balance, while the correction reads the fee entries, the purchase and payment history and the cross-category holdings - so no second order exists that could produce the same terminal state by another route.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Replaying the task with the correction write skipped and everything else unchanged leaves the fee reversals inside the six-month window at 0.00, so the settlement target rises from 412.35 to 435.35, the quotient rises from 32,988 to 34,828 and the scored points_redeemed rises from 33,000 to 35,000. The terminal state also loses the 23.00 reversal entry and keeps the balance owed at 6,004.95 instead of 5,981.95.

prerequisite_closure.no_user_hint: user_scenario names no policy, no fee and no reversal. The caller's whole contribution is the request to apply her points to the card balance, her identity and locating details, her preference that the credit land on the card itself, and passive answers. The only sentence that touches the correction at all is a reaction - 'Whenever the agent mentions that something has been put back onto the card, she takes it in good part ... she does not know what it relates to and does not ask' - which fires only after the agent has said so, gives no direction, and would never occur if the agent never found the correction. Neither the string 'card_ext_late_fee_correction' nor the words 'late fee', 'reversal' or 'correction' appear anywhere in the persona.
prerequisite_closure.tools_do_not_block: redeem_card_points_9bfb7edb checks nothing about fees or reversals: its body looks up the card account, computes the remaining points, creates one card_rewards_redeem row and updates rewards_balance. It has no branch that inspects card_fee or card_fee_reversal rows, returns no policy-based Error and gives no hint. An agent that never books the correction can still call it and it will faithfully write whatever point count is passed - the consequence shows up only as a different terminal hash. reverse_card_late_fee_4ff0f41c likewise performs no eligibility check beyond confirming the card account row exists so it can compute the new balance.
